A torrent of roaring orange fire erupting from its jaws, casting hot flickering light across its scales.
A long plume of pale frost-breath fogging from its maw, ice crystals glittering in the cold air around its head.
Forks of blue lightning crackling across its horns and down its spine, electric light flickering over its scales.
A warm glow of inner bioluminescence pulsing through its translucent scales, lighting its body from deep within.
A wreath of thick dark smoke curling from its nostrils and drifting heavily around its neck and shoulders.
Molten embers constantly shedding from its hide, drifting downward like falling sparks cooling in the open air.
A shimmer of refracted crystal light scattering across every surface near it, prismatic colors dancing off its scales.
A sickly green soul-flame guttering in its eye sockets and licking softly along the ridges of its skull.
A billowing cloud of toxic swamp-spores drifting from its gills, hanging in a sickly green haze around it.
A halo of warm golden radiance emanating from its crest, bathing the air around its head in soft light.
A swirl of stinging sand and howling wind circling its body, grit spiraling outward from its beating wings.
A slow drip of glowing acid beading from its fangs, each drop sizzling and eating into the ground below.
Tendrils of violet shadow-smoke unraveling from its wingtips, twisting darkly as it moves through dim or failing light.
A shimmer of heat distortion rippling outward from its scales, the air above its back warping and wavering visibly.
Ribbons of sea-foam and salt mist trailing from its fins, the air around it thick with the smell of ocean.
A cascade of tiny pale snowflakes continuously falling from its body, drifting slowly downward in a quiet frozen flurry.
A pulse of deep red lava-light throbbing beneath its cracked and darkened scales, glowing brighter with each breath it draws.
A dense cloud of black ash billowing softly from its back, coating every nearby surface in a fine grey dust.
Arcs of wild static electricity jumping between the spines along its back, hair-thin bolts snapping and hissing continuously.
A faint shimmer of invisibility rippling across its scales, its outline blurring and distorting like a heat mirage in motion.
A surge of churning dark water perpetually rushing around its lower body, swirling in a contained and powerful current.
Threads of pale silver moonlight leaking from the gaps between its scales, faint and cold and softly illuminating the dark.
A bloom of luminescent spores puffing outward from beneath its wings with each downstroke, glowing faintly as they scatter.
A haze of shimmering copper-tinted smoke breathing outward from its snout, carrying the sharp metallic scent of heated ore.
A slow spreading pool of inky darkness seeping outward from wherever its feet touch, swallowing light at its edges.
